brief:
Middle East Eye reported that organisers in Italy have mobilised members of the Albanian diaspora to sail back to Albania in support of the Flamingo Revolution, an ongoing protest movement in the country. The campaign represents a significant effort to draw international participation in the demonstrations from diaspora communities abroad.

The Italian organisers have explicitly connected the Albanian protest movement to the Palestinian cause, framing both struggles as part of a wider fight for rights and self-determination. This linkage reflects an attempt to situate the Flamingo Revolution within a transnational solidarity movement spanning multiple regions and political struggles.

title: Italian diaspora returns to Albania to back Flamingo Revolution protest
